purpose: Deterministic decomposition of the already completed Q041/T060 and Q045/T065 fixed-alpha evidence to identify descriptive drawdown mechanisms before any new tuning, allocation search or performance trial.

diagnostic_scope.sleeve_decomposition: CONTROL only: fixed 50/50 trend and cross-sectional sleeves

regime_definition.market_return: equal-weight mean of the fixed universe's open-to-open asset returns for the evaluated day
regime_definition.trend_state: positive/negative prior-63-evaluated-day compounded market return, excluding the evaluated day
regime_definition.volatility_state: 21-day population standard deviation of prior evaluated-day market returns, compared with the median of the preceding 252 available 21-day volatility observations, excluding the evaluated day
regime_definition.early_period: days without the full lookback are reported as UNDEFINED_EARLY and excluded from regime comparison

drawdown_definition.equity: compounded base-cost net daily return already represented by the fixed runner
drawdown_definition.global_max_drawdown_interval: from the running-equity peak immediately preceding the trough that attains the largest drawdown through that trough, inclusive
drawdown_definition.symbol_attribution: sum of symbol-level gross return contribution less symbol-allocated turnover cost over the exact interval; descriptive simple-return attribution, not a causal statement

overlap_definition.active_signal_set: symbols with non-zero weight in each fixed alpha arm on the evaluated day
overlap_definition.pairwise_overlap: daily Jaccard similarity of active signal sets
overlap_definition.adverse_overlap: same metric restricted to days on which the fixed CONTROL equity is below its running peak

correlation_definition.series: base-cost net daily returns reconstructed from the fixed frozen snapshot
correlation_definition.overall: Pearson correlation across all evaluated days
correlation_definition.adverse: Pearson correlation restricted to CONTROL-underwater days

cost_definition.allocation: diagnostic only: each day's symbol cost is proportional to that symbol's absolute weight change; no change to the original fixed runner
